evidence.snippet: Financial Aid Appeal Process Students who fail to meet SAP requirements at the end of the warning semester may submit a SAP appeal through Workday to the Office of Financial Aid if extenuating circumstances (such as the death of a close relative, an injury or sickness of student, or other extenuating circumstance) existed which negatively impacted the student’s ability to make SAP.
Both the SAP appeal form and a copy of the Academic Plan must be submitted through Workday within thirty days of the SAP denial notification in order for the appeal to be considered.

In evaluating a SAP appeal, the Office of Financial Aid considers both the extenuating circumstances that led to the failure to make SAP and whether the student will be able to meet SAP standards by (i) the end of the following academic term or (ii) a specific later date by adhering to an academic plan.
